name: Stock Bros
overview:
In the cutthroat and aggressive world of Wall Street, three ambitious brokers decide that following the market isn't enough—they want to dominate it. Between IPOs, stock fluctuations, and an unyielding pursuit of maximum profit, the "Stock Bros" discover that the most intense negotiations don't always happen in front of computer screens.

In this NakedSword original series, the heat rises as corporate tensions boil over into private encounters, proving that in the financial market, demand is high and the supply is always generous. When the numbers go up, the clothes come off, and true business partnerships are sealed long after closing bell.
